name: Home
description: EXP-011 §65 fixture: a WebSocket node (`socket`, URL ws://localhost:8583/, Auto Connect left at its default of true) with Connect / Stop / Send buttons and a Text Input written through to a `message` Variable that feeds its Message — the live-chat shape. Connection State, Connected, Queue Size, Received, Received Raw and Last Error each shown in a Text; On Open / On Close / On Reconnect / Failure write a `status` Variable through four String-fed Set Variables.
